notes: Extracted to WFLW_images/ and WFLW_annotations/. Each face: 98 landmarks, detection rect, 6 attribute flags (list_98pt_rect_attr_{train,test}.txt); test subsets = faces with that flag = 1 (counts equal list_98pt_test/*.txt). FaRL/HRNet evaluate with HRNet's csv boxes (center/scale); that csv is only on OneDrive (login required since Microsoft's share-API change), Cloudstor (shut down) and Baidu, so eval/eval_wflw.py derives the identical box from the GT landmarks with the formula given in HRNet issue #3 (center=(floor(min)+ceil(max))/2, scale=max side/200). Landmark index semantics checked on GT: 60/64 outer/inner corner of the image-left eye, 68/72 inner/outer of the image-right eye, 96/97 pupils, 54 nose tip, 76/82 image-left/right outer mouth corners, contour 0 -> 32 image-left -> image-right.
